children: surges 8.6% in Monday's trading as Needham initiated coverage with a Buy rating and $33 price target, citing the company's development of the KRONOS MMR Energy System, a high-temperature gas-cooled reactor.
Needham analyst Sean Milligan said his thesis rests primarily on the KRONOS reactor, which NANO Nuclear

acquired for $8.5M after nearly a decade of development by USNC, and the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign has moved the ~15 MW electric reactor into formal Nuclear Regulatory Commission construction permit review, with key milestones expected in 2027.

The analyst said KRONOS' ~9.9% initial enrichment could ease fuel sourcing compared to designs requiring ~19.75%, while the company maintains $580M of liquidity to fund operations through the critical licensing phase.

The commercial pipeline is large but predominantly non-binding, making UIUC execution, a documented first-core fuel pathway, and conversion of customer frameworks into binding, customer-funded agreements the key de-risking events, Milligan said.

title: NANO Nuclear Energy initiated with Buy rating at Needham as Kronos enters NRC review
